summary: No new evidence is submitted this turn; the previously validated consistency fix stands as the submission. The audit is at a completed state for all four questions: one asserted defect with ten receipts and five independent controls, two bounded safety negatives with their scope stated, one recovery scenario, and a read-index boundary control that confines the defect to the MsgProp entry points. The knowledge record is consistent, with the boundary statement carrying its receipt and no stale claim that it was unobserved. Work prepared for the next turn rather than submitted unverified: a new test for snapshot-based resynchronization, the one recovery path the earlier scenario explicitly excluded. It stops a member, commits another entry, compacts the leader's log past that member's next index so the append path cannot catch up, creates and compacts a snapshot on the leader, restarts the member, advances the clock fifteen rounds, and records whether the snapshot was installed and whether a proposal made afterwards reached the resynchronized member. That test has not been compiled or run yet, so it is deliberately outside this submission and will be verified before anything is submitted from it.
